unittest.scope: pure stdlib documentation only; no FE

script:
import gzip, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

root=Path('/home/fenics/Projects/NN-Lab')
base='6166ad27e36c08408f81d4bba07d2f6b035e9f2b'
docs=root/'docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse'
rec=docs/'outcomes/records'
target=rec/'review_v36_documentation_checks.json'
target.write_text('{}\n')
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse/README.md'],cwd=root)
assert (docs/'README.md').read_bytes().endswith(old)
report=docs/'review_report_v35.md'
lines=report.read_text().splitlines()
inside=False;fences=[];links=[];tables=[];width=None
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if line.startswith('```'):
        inside=not inside;fences.append(dict(line=i,syntax=line))
        continue
    if inside:continue
    assert '$$' not in line and '\\[' not in line and '\\]' not in line,(i,line)
    if line.startswith('|'):
        count=len(line.split('|'))
        if width is None:width=count;tables.append(dict(start=i,columns=count-2))
        assert count==width,(i,count,width)
    else:width=None
    for label,link in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)',line):
        if link.startswith(('https://','http://')):continue
        path=(report.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        assert path.exists(),(i,link)
        links.append(dict(line=i,path=link))
assert not inside and len(fences)==0
test_started=time.perf_counter()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','-q','src.test.test_26_documentation_contract'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
elapsed=time.perf_counter()-test_started
assert r.returncode==0,r.stdout+r.stderr
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=root,check=True)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','src','benchmarks','input','scripts'],cwd=root)
raw={'raw_review_evidence': []}
for name in ('review_v36_repository_index.gz','review_v36_metadata_audit.py.gz'):
    compressed=(rec/name).read_bytes()
    expanded=gzip.decompress(compressed)
    if name.endswith('repository_index.gz'):
        assert expanded==(root/'tmp/task042/review_v36/repository_index.json').read_bytes()
    else:
        compile(expanded.decode(), name, 'exec')
    raw['raw_review_evidence'].append(dict(path=name,sha256=sha(compressed),uncompressed_sha256=sha(expanded),bytes=len(expanded)))

out=dict(schema='task042.review36.docs.v1',UTC=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),reviewed_HEAD=base,
    files={str(p.relative_to(root)):dict(sha256=sha(p.read_bytes()),bytes=p.stat().st_size) for p in (report,docs/'README.md')},
    README_original_suffix_sha256=sha(old),historical_suffix_unchanged=True,review_math_fences=fences,
    review_tables=tables,local_links_checked=links,raw_review_archives_verified=len(raw['raw_review_evidence']),review_archive_hashes=raw['raw_review_evidence'],
    unittest=dict(command='python -m unittest -q src.test.test_26_documentation_contract',returncode=r.returncode,
        stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr,elapsed_including_startup_seconds=elapsed,scope='pure stdlib documentation only; no FE'),
    diff_check='PASS',no_source_edits=True,GitHub_visual='NOT_VERIFIED',CI='NOT_RUN',script=Path(__file__).read_text())
target.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(local_links=len(links),tables=len(tables),math_blocks=len(fences)//2,unittest=r.stderr.strip(),diff_check='PASS'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
